snippet_primary: "Over a year ago, I traveled to the Bologna Children's Book Fair with my freshly printed portfolio, looking for clarity and a new spark. That trip led to a big shift in my art journey. I decided to pause children's book illustration and started focusing on creating art for products and licensing. Now, one year (and 300 Etsy sales!) later, I'm celebrating the joy and balance I've found in making and selling my own artwork."
